property: The operator-visible transaction grammar built around HELO/MAIL/RCPT/DATA/RSET/VRFY/EXPN/HELP/NOOP/QUIT and three-digit replies remains recognizable in modern SMTP while extensions and obsolete verbs branch around it.

sources.supports: modern command grammar, HELO compatibility and EHLO preference

negative_claims: Not every RFC 821 command remains current; SEND/SOML/SAML and TURN belong to extinct/obsolete branches.
Normative survival does not mean commands such as VRFY/EXPN are operationally unrestricted.
open_questions: Build command-by-command status matrix and extension keyword genealogy.
